[SWS_DM_CONSTR_00961] Limits of priority values
⌈
The DM shall only support
DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.priority
values in the range of 1..255.
⌋
7.3.4.4.2 UDS DTC Status
7.3.4.4.2.1 Status processing
The ’UDS DTC Status processing’ is the DMs ability to record and retain UDS status
and associated interactions with other SW parts.
